observation: Two existing original routes yield 729 exact movement sweeps, 3230 triangle queries, 10538 signed areas and 5594 height calls. Separate captures verify 3573 lengths, 9245 square roots, 634 slope normalizations, 103 edge normalizations and 160 edge atan results. Every one of 119 independent control artifacts agrees per route; 157 corruptions are rejected.
interpretation: The ordinary and special sweeps use different probe order, source adjacency/terrain rules and conditional edge/slope projection. Queries preserve their exact point, attribute and edge write order, including edge padding. The authored coordinator directly calculates every nested query and intermediate geometry result. Later position/layer integration remains separate.
author: Codex /root, independent original-source and execution analysis on 2026-09-08

preconditions: Exact selected original Disc1 and source profile, existing control/jump and east-ramp input routes, pinned Nix tooling and fresh private output directories.
The control route uses the preserved memory sampler. The ramp route has no sampler. Both use the existing cold-boot adapter without new setup writes.
Build and run the uninstrumented control using #observation separately from the read-only #observation-trace core.
commands: python tools/reference/scenario.py <existing-route.json> --content "discs/Xenogears disc 1.chd" --output <new-private-control> (add the recorded --sample-memory only for the control route)
Run the same route three times, each with its generated --trace-instructions specification and a fresh private output directory.

python -m unittest tests.test_sweep_math tests.test_collision_query tests.test_movement_sweep tests.test_sweep_trace
validation.expected: Exact source, input-derived arithmetic, complete captured actor/caller/edge/shared memory, original stack/return ordering, cross-recording boundaries and independent control artifacts. Reject source, trace, omission and provenance substitutions.
validation.actual: All six specifications regenerate exactly and all six captures qualify below budget without failed guards or unavailable ranges. Every modeled stage and 119 control artifacts agrees. All 157 corruptions and omissions are rejected; 36 authored tests pass.
validation.tolerance: Exact integer/byte/hash equality. Probe Y is explicitly unread, not a zero store. Uncaptured writes, GTE register side effects and hardware timing are not asserted.

unobserved_source_branches: Initial triangle -1, missing neighbor, mask7 and the 32-iteration cap.
Attribute-disable controls, alternative actor/terrain restrictions, query mode80 and other modes.
Special forced floor, other actor/layer/terrain combinations and ordinary slope-selection branches absent from these routes.
Negative square-root inputs, original atan BREAK paths and uncaptured GTE state.
limitations: Source-derived models and authored fixtures cover more branches than these original routes; those branches remain labeled unobserved.
The 8508 scratchpad vertex observations match source geometry, but their copy lineage is unreconstructed. Full runtime collision-component bytes qualify separately.
Full active motion and animation, later position/layer/floor/ceiling/rollback, history/follower, camera/contact and semantic readiness remain required.
Only the exact Disc1 routes are observed here. Shared overlay identity does not substitute for Disc2 execution or other fields.
All15 broad Phase1 todos and nine slice proof domains remain open; independent review and native gameplay remain unimplemented.

provenance.game_specific_sources: Only supplied original discs, binaries, data and execution; no other Xenogears project source or reverse-engineering results.
